definitions.gloss: to move; to transfer; to shift
definitions.explanation: To move something from one place to another. The transitive counterpart to 移る (to move/change).
To transmit an illness or disease to another person.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{中身|なかみ}を{別|べつ}の{箱|はこ}に{移|うつ}した。
examples.english: I moved the contents of the box to another box.

examples.japanese: {本社|ほんしゃ}を{東京|とうきょう}に{移|うつ}す。
examples.english: We will move the headquarters to Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{人|ひと}に{移|うつ}さないように{気|き}をつける。
examples.english: I'm careful not to pass my cold on to others.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {移|うつ}る.

ASPECT: {移|うつ}している indicates ongoing action of moving/transferring.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xを〜に{移|うつ}す (to move X to ~)
・{視線|しせん}を{移|うつ}す (to shift one's gaze)
・{風邪|かぜ}を{移|うつ}す (to pass on a cold)

PAIR VERB:
・{移|うつ}る (intransitive - to move, to change)
